remarks: Welcome to your dream home, nestled on 4.73 pristine acres in the desirable upper west side 4-acre zone of New Canaan. This exquisite 5-bedroom, 3-bath, and 2-half bath residence offers 3,808 sq. ft. of above-grade living space, complemented by an additional 1,500 sq. ft. of finished walk-out lower level space.  As you step into the large entry foyer, you'll be greeted by the warmth of the oversized living room with fireplace. The eat-in kitchen, a culinary ideal for family gatherings and entertaining guests, opens up to a large family room with an additional fireplace and a back deck overlooking the gracious property.  Outside, the professionally landscaped grounds feature mature trees and plantings, offering both beauty and privacy. Enjoy summer days by the in-ground pool, a perfect retreat for relaxation and fun. Situated on a quiet cul-de-sac, this home provides the tranquility and safety ideal for family living.  Experience the best of both worlds with easy access to the vibrant communities of New Canaan and Pound Ridge while savoring the peace of a secluded suburban haven.
